groups.label: T/V 路由与完整对象恢复
性能测量与阶段可观测性

semantics.source/csv_v1: Explicit schema and CSV parser; matching canonical typed T/V input; bad rows rejected.
semantics.source/npy_v1: Explicit shapes/roles, separated i64 T and f64 V; reject object/pickle arrays.
semantics.source/txt_v1: Explicit delimited TXT schema; matching canonical input; no silent inference.
semantics.type/exact_v1: Restore original dtype, shape, order, validity and required bit patterns.
semantics.type/checked_conversion_v1: Checked casts or reversible bitcasts; no silent overflow, truncation, or loss of signed zero.
semantics.special/mask_bits_v1: Preserve mask, required NaN payloads and non-finite bit patterns; account for sidecars.
semantics.quality/bounded_quantization_v1: Validate explicit bound in final original domain; bill exception stream and inverse conversion.
semantics.quality/repair_fallback_v1: Validate in original domain; bill actual attempts, repairs and explicitly allowed fallback; no unearned codec attribution.
semantics.route/whole_object_v1: Restore a shared T with its semantics and all V groups in exact order; a stored shared T is counted once.
semantics.execution/external_parallel_v1: Bound all native plus framework workers; measure overall wall, CPU, memory and all coordination costs.
semantics.execution/observed_isa_v1: Check requested and effective backend and loaded binary prerequisites; disclose actual codec and adapter ISA separately.
semantics.stream/chunked_v1: Freeze input cadence, bounded buffer and batch wait, backpressure, first output, finish and tail handling; report full flow costs.
semantics.point_read/service_v1: Recover the addressed point with required quality; account for decoder and access amplification, even for full-decode fallback.
semantics.range_read/service_v1: Recover specified row interval; disclose accessed bytes, decoded points and read amplification.
semantics.query/service_v1: Use a fixed original-domain query and numeric policy; include decode/aggregation/index cost.
semantics.progressive/quality_service_v1: Independently validate each declared refinement and report incremental and cumulative costs.
semantics.mutable/persistent_v1: Measure read-modify-write and flush; reopen persistent output and verify update and reconstruction contract.
semantics.checkpoint/replay_v1: Resume from a declared boundary or replay with full cost; verify durable state and independent recovery.
semantics.model/deployment_v1: Freeze, load, account for and verify all decode-required models/dictionaries; detect wrong and missing assets.
semantics.training/budgeted_v1: Disjoint training/development/held-out inputs, frozen budget and actual chosen parameters; no test-set oracle.
semantics.restore/independent_v1: Restore without original inputs in a fresh process, using only actual output and declared dependencies.
semantics.measurement/l0_l1_v1: Measure L0 total operation and L1 stages in independent passes; preserve coverage, clocks and failed/missing observations.
